newsitem.title: CHINA: Two Chinese to die for illegal stock trading.
newsitem.headline: Two Chinese to die for illegal stock trading.

text.p: A court in east China has sentenced two men to death for using more than 100 million yuan ($12 million) in public funds to trade stocks on their own account, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
The court, in Jiaxing in Zhejiang province, also sentenced three others involved in the case to prison terms of 18 years, 10 years and 15 months respectively, it said.

The two sentenced to death, Li Weimin and Shen Jiazeng, were formerly manager and deputy manager of the share trading department of the Jiaxing Trust and Investment Company. Two of the other sentenced people also worked there, it said.

Between December 1992 and November 15, 1994, when the crime was discovered, the four people and a fifth man who worked in the city's trade union federation used more than 100 million yuan to trade stocks for themselves, it said.
The trading caused losses to the country totalling 7.64 million yuan, it said.
Once the case came to light, the five were found to have in their possession more than 7.5 million yuan, it said.
The court imposed the stiff sentences because of the sums of money involved and seriousness of the offences, the newspaper said but gave no more details.
